text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hrm... I wish my glasses wouldn't fog up
after
practice.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I've almost tripped thanks to that fog...
But I
don't think I'm ready for contacts.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. My glasses are a part of me. If
only I
could find lenses that didn't fog—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That's it! If we cannot buy them, we
need only
make some! I'll speak to
Tachyon at once.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
T-Tachyon? I think you might be onto
something,
but... I'm not sure asking her
is a good idea.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You know... Tachyon's experiments
always make
Cafe run and hide in the
library...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But trial and error is necessary for
progress. We
cannot expect results
without sacrifice.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry. I will be that sacrifice. Once
a
prototype has been prepared, I shall
let you
know.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ummm... Well... D-don't push yourself,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Even if Tachyon's research
leaves me
with a pair of glasses with
legs... I will continue
on!
